basic_profile.bio: An ardent fan of the Harry Potter universe, I have been engaging in the community for over a decade. As a software developer based in Portland, Oregon, I spend my evenings and weekends diving into various fandoms, including my latest obsession with the Haas F1 Team. Currently in a committed relationship, I enjoy the balance between my career and my hobbies. My typical online hours are late evenings, often after 8 PM PST, where I unwind with a mix of gaming and reading.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in computer science from Oregon State University, my expertise extends into software development, where I specialize in creating interactive web applications. My passion for gaming and digital content creation has fueled my self-taught journey in game design and mod development.
